sanitize_input_number: sanitize a number input by converting strings to int or float and returning None for invalid types
generate_number_segments: generate Bengali unit segments like koti, lokkho, hazar, sotok, and ekok from an integer
extract_float_and_int: extract the integer and fractional parts of a number as a tuple of two integers
generate_whole_part_words: generate Bengali words for the whole part of a number using precomputed segments
convert_fraction_to_words: convert a numeric fraction to its Bengali digit-by-digit word representation
